question: The greatest number that on dividing 2675 and 2320 leaves the remainder 5 and 6 , respectively is :
solution:
Concept used:

HCF is the largest number or quantity that is a factor of each member of a group of numbers.

Calculation:

The greatest number is the HCF of (2675 - 5) i.e., 2670 and (2320 - 6) i.e., 2314.

2670 = 178 × 15

2314 = 178 × 13

HCF (2670, 2314) = 178

**∴ The greatest number that on dividing 2675 and 2320 leaves the remainder 5 and 6 respectively is 178.**
